messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout v7.0.2 -> 5% traffic to eu-west-1 and us-east-1. Change window: 01:00-03:00 UTC. Health checks: 15m error-rate + p95 latency. Release notes: <internal/release/7.0.2>

marie: Early telemetry: getting a steady rise in 500s from session-db in eu-west-1 after ~4m. Not huge yet but trending: 0.04% -> 0.5% in 6m.

dan: I can repro a spike in connection timeouts to the read-replica when load hits pooled clients with long-lived statements. p95 db latency doubled. Sample traces attached.

faizal: This release changed connection pool idle eviction to keep idle conns open longer to avoid reconnect churn (aim: perf). Seems like under short-lived spikes it's exhausting available connections and causing queueing.

marie: If it's pool retention + a slight spike, that explains why we only see it on canaries. We should avoid a full rollback for other regions if unaffected. Suggest: PAUSE the rollout, PIN eu-west-1 to v7.0.1, apply a temporary runtime cap to pool.max_open=100 across canary nodes, and open a hotfix to revert retention behavior.

oncall-bot: @amir, @dan 1: oncall is amir. Pager notified.

amir: Oncall here. Quick triage Q: Is this a database resource exhaustion or client-side leak? If DB-level, pinning might buy time. If client is leaking, revert asap.

dan: Traces show connection wait times piling up; DB metrics show active connections at repo max. Looks like the client pool is holding more connections than expected. Repro steps: 
```
# repro: synthetic burst against canary
python tools/sim_db_load.py --clients 400 --idle-keep=120s
```
Results: connection queue grows after 90s, causing 500s.

faizal: Hotfix plan: 1) add back eviction (idle timeout 30s) and 2) add telemetry for pool_usage. Runtime mitigation: set pool.max_open=100 for canary fleet. I'll open PR and push config change.

marie: Proposal to ops: pause ramp and pin eu-west-1 to v7.0.1 now. Then apply runtime cap and observe for 10m. If stable, merge hotfix and run staging smoke before unpin.

amir: Agreed. I'll execute pause + pin. Commands: 
```
# pause rollout
deployctl rollout pause --version=7.0.2 --strategy=percent
# pin region
deployctl pin --version=7.0.1 --routes=eu-west-1 --reason="conn-pool exhaustion on canary"
```

ops-bot: Note: pinning will route new sessions to pinned version; existing long-lived connections may still hit canary for up to 2m. Expect transient metrics to settle.

amir: Running now. exec-id: exec-20260323-711.

deploy-bot: Rollout paused by amir (exec-20260323-711). No further percent increases will be applied.

deploy-bot: Pins applied: eu-west-1 -> v7.0.1.

marie: Pin confirmed. Creating incident INC-20260323-999 and assigning faizal + dan for hotfix and telemetry.

faizal: Hotfix PR opened: connpool#410 (restore idle eviction + pool_usage metrics). Also applying runtime cap: infractl set cluster-config --key=pool.max_open --value=100 --scope=canary. Pushing config now.

dan: Starting staging smoke with hotfix branch and adding a 10m hold to watch p95 and connection queue.

marie: If runtime cap stabilizes metrics in 10m we can consider unpin + 2% reintroduce, otherwise full rollback. Let's be conservative.

amir: Monitoring: after cap applied, connection queue length fell and 500s dropped from 0.5% -> 0.06% in 5m. Good signal but continuing 10m observation.

faizal: Staging smoke passed for 12m without reproducing the queue growth. Merging hotfix and preparing a small canary re-release with eviction enabled.

marie: After merge, plan: unpin eu-west-1, resume rollout to a guarded 2% for 15m, and observe. If healthy, continue to 10% per normal policy. If not, pause and revert.

amir: Commands to unpin & resume: 
```
# unpin region
deployctl unpin --routes=eu-west-1 --reason="hotfix merged, staging verified"
# small resume
deployctl rollout resume --version=7.0.2 --to-percent=2 --strategy=percent
```

deploy-bot: Pin removed by amir (exec-20260323-712).

deploy-bot: Rollout resumed: v7.0.2 -> 2% traffic (eu-west-1 added).

marie: Monitoring first 15m: connection queue steady, p95 latency stable, 500s ~0.02%. No retries amplification seen.

dan: 15m check complete and green. Execute continue to 10%: `deployctl rollout continue --version=7.0.2 --to-percent=10`

deploy-bot: Rollout scaled to 10% by amir (exec-20260323-713).

marie: Post-action notes: STOP when build causes resource amplification, pin affected region instead of global rollback when safe, apply runtime mitigations first if available, validate staging, then cautious reintroduce. Add a CI test that simulates pool retention under burst load.

amir: Incident INC-20260323-999 created, will convert to a postmortem ticket and assign owners for action items. Closing this stop/go call.

deploy-bot: Thread closed. Reopen or @amir for urgent follow-up.
